## What it is

An editable, named-component reconstruction of the Neewer GM-MP2 140 mm macro focusing rail. The default pose follows the product photograph, with the rotating top Arca clamp turned one 90-degree detent transverse to the rail. Use the `reference_pose` variant for comparison against the supplied scan.

The manufacturer specifies 140 mm carriage travel, four 90-degree rotation locks, double Arca quick release, 1/4-inch and 3/8-inch mounting points, 512 g mass, and 2.5 kg payload. Source: https://neewer.com/products/neewer-gm-mp2-140mm-macro-focusing-rail-slider-with-360-rotation-66606520

## Design notes

- The bottom Arca plate, end blocks, rods, lead screw, focus knob, carriage, rotary base, fixed top Arca clamp, movable top Arca jaw, and clamp knob remain separately selectable components.
- The bottom mounting interface follows four repeated scan sections as two continuous edge extrusions from x=4 to 203 mm. Its 46-degree engagement flanks remain sharp and the open centre is preserved.
- The top clamp follows the scanned 49.1 by 54.25 mm footprint. Its fixed and movable jaws form a 37.9 mm upper opening and 42.8 mm seat opening with approximately 50-degree flanks, and the twin seat pockets retain the measured 36.95 mm floor and 15 mm centre bridge.
- `references/neewer-outer-focus-sleeve.step` is preserved as exact B-rep geometry and placed on the scan-derived large-knob axis. Its outer cylinder is 22 mm diameter and 5 mm wide; its eightfold opening is the authoritative tight-fit interface.
- Fitting that opening to the scan gave 0.097 mm median radial clearance (about 0.19 mm diametral) and 0.093 mm RMS residual. Tiny negative patches remain, so these scan-derived fit values stay provisional.
- Scan-derived values in `measurements.toml` remain provisional. The CAD uses analytic primitives and intentionally omits triangle noise, branding, scale markings, rubber texture, fastener threads, and cosmetic knurling.
- The supplied scan captures the top Arca clamp in its longitudinal detent. The `reference_pose` variant isolates that pose difference from the default product-photo detent.
- The stored `.ply.gz` is a deterministic geometry-only binary PLY conversion of the supplied `neewer-macro-slide-GM-MP2.stl`. It preserves all 126,072 vertices, 252,204 faces, bounds, and area from the repaired watertight STL; the source STL SHA-256 is `1d134187bd303830bd58c082fa5f4268afb295ea5a70fbf575cf312dcc17f5c7`.
- A post-revision 3,000-sample bidirectional comparison of `reference_pose` at the declared 0.75 mm tolerance estimated 54.5% CAD-to-reference coverage with 7.96 mm p95, and 66.5% reference-to-CAD coverage with 7.59 mm p95. The largest CAD-to-reference residual remains an internal contact face beneath the separately selectable rotary base. The intentionally omitted support feet now contribute to the reference-to-CAD residual, together with the simplified carriage and omitted threads, markings, rubber pads, fasteners, and texture. These figures describe a useful editable reconstruction, not a surface-accurate replica.

## Don't

- Do not replace the exact outer-focus sleeve with a traced mesh or a circular guess.
- Do not use the product photograph for dimensions.
- Do not assess whole-model deviation in the default operating pose; compare the `reference_pose` variant.
